# Vinícius Dalastra

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years building scalable, secure platforms across payments,
> SaaS, real-time messaging, e-commerce and public-sector systems. Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil;
> available remotely across LATAM. Portuguese (native), English (C1).

Personal portfolio and CV of Vinícius Dalastra. The site is a static two-language site
(English at the root, Brazilian Portuguese under /pt-br/) with no framework and no external requests.

## Summary

- **Role**: Senior Full-Stack Engineer / Tech Lead, backend specialist.
- **Experience**: 10+ years (since 2015).
- **Core stack**: Node.js (TypeScript), NestJS, Express, Angular, React, Next.js, MongoDB,
  PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, Redis, Docker, CI/CD, AWS, Azure.
- **Specialities**: microservices, REST and Graph APIs, event-driven architecture, webhooks,
  WebSockets, payment gateways, SQL optimization, information security (LGPD/GDPR),
  AI integrations (GPT API, agents, automation).
- **Track record**: payment gateway supporting R$1.8B+ in processed sales across 3,000+ e-commerce
  platforms; omnichannel messaging platform handling millions of real-time messages; supplier
  portals serving 15,000+ suppliers; led an 8-person engineering squad.
- **Contact**: viniciusdalastra@hotmail.com · +55 47 99643-4266 · linkedin.com/in/dalastraa
